query: Which precise mixed‑effects model specifications will we pre‑register (fixed contrasts, planned interactions, random intercepts and slopes), and what diagnostics and explicit nonconvergence protocols will we include?

response.query: Which precise mixed‑effects model specifications will we pre‑register (fixed contrasts, planned interactions, random intercepts and slopes), and what diagnostics and explicit nonconvergence protocols will we include?
response.answer: We will pre-register a mixed-effects model with fixed contrasts, planned interactions, random intercepts, and slopes. Diagnostics will include model fit checks, and nonconvergence protocols will involve re-specification and re-estimation.
